content.short: First educational mini-series on Cardano. The collection of 4500 NFTs is a homage to cult movie classics.
content.description:
Coolpacas are collection of 4500 NFT's created as a homage to some of our favourite cult classics such as Eraser head, They Live or 5th Element just to name a few. The traits were algorithmically generated resulting in some really funky combinations. Our mission is to create first animated educational mini series on Cardano blockchain. We want to focus on fun & engaging storytelling rather than boring factual content.

Our core team has extensive experience in delivering high quality educational content for clients such as BBC Three, BBC Bitesize or BBC Teach. We chose alpacas/coolpacas because of their cute appearance and surreal quality, which lends itself beautifully, into the world we want to create.
